Roof collapse at Pakistan tuition center kills 14 children

A roof collapse at a private tuition center in Lahore, Pakistan, has resulted in the deaths of at least 14 children. Preliminary reports indicate the center was unregistered and operating in a residential building with a dilapidated roof. Authorities have arrested individuals in connection with the incident, and investigations into the construction and registration are underway.
